description:
i016 (tx-cow-head-realloc, snapshot s05) complete. 4 findings, 12 classified candidates, artifact at agent-state/findings/i016.json.

FINDINGS (all same-function capture-into-skb-head -> head-reallocating helper -> stale dereference shape as seed pep_get_sb; pskb_expand_head semantics verified in-snapshot at net/core/skbuff.c:1481/1912 'All the pointers pointing into skb header may change and must be reloaded'):

1. s05:net/mac80211/wpa.c:799-818 (medium) ieee80211_crypto_cs_encrypt(): hdr = (struct ieee80211_hdr *)skb->data at 799; pskb_expand_head(skb, iv_len, 0, GFP_ATOMIC) at 812 runs when headroom < iv_len (nhead>0 always reallocates/frees old head); stale hdr->frame_control read at 815 yields hdrlen used as the memmove length at line 818 — stale read whose value drives a copy length.

2. s05:net/batman-adv/routing.c:227-238 (medium) batadv_recv_my_icmp_packet(): icmph captured at 227 from attacker-controlled mesh ICMP skb; skb_linearize at 234; stale icmph passed to batadv_socket_receive_packet(icmph, skb->len) at 237 which copies header bytes from possibly-freed old head into the userspace-visible ping socket queue (UAF read/info leak). Cross-confirmed as the top s02 finding by intent i007.

3. s05:net/batman-adv/network-coding.c:1113-1169 (medium) batadv_nc_code_packets(): packet1/packet2 captured at 1113-1114/1124-1125 (one from a stored skb_clone of an RX packet, guaranteeing pskb_expand_head frees the shared head); skb_linearize of both skbs at 1145; stale packet1->ttl/dest/ttvn and packet2->dest/ttl/ttvn read at 1155-1169 and copied into a transmitted coded packet. Cross-confirmed in s02 by i007.

4. s05:net/mac80211/tdls.c:1924-1940 (low) ieee80211_process_tdls_channel_switch(): tf = (void *)skb->data at 1924; skb_linearize at 1934; tf->action_code read at 1940 with no refetch, dispatching TDLS channel-switch kernel state. Same pattern confirmed in s01/s02/s03 siblings.

SAFE candidates with concrete evidence: ip_tunnel_core.c (s01's iptunnel_pmtud_build_icmp absent in s05 — grep negative; __iptunnel_pull_header captures after pulls), ip_tunnel.c:626/811 (all inner_iph uses precede the cow), ip_gre.c:607 (capture after cow; accessors used post-cow in erspan_fb_xmit), seg6_iptunnel.c:120/181 (captures after cow), calipso.c:1332 (explicit refetch with comment), act_pedit.c:314 / act_ipt.c:235 (unclone before captures), ipvlan_core.c:608 (skb_share_check never relocates head), xfrm_ipcomp.c:112/178 (linearize before captures).

BOUNDED NEGATIVE EVIDENCE: automated same-function capture->realloc->no-refetch->use scan over all net/ and drivers/ .c files yielded only 3 raw hits (tdls.c, wpa.c, ipvlan_core.c) plus the manually-read batman-adv sites; mt7925 mcu.c linearize site present in s01/s03 does not exist in s05 (no mt7925 directory, no skb_linearize under mt76/).

LIMITATIONS: no runtime/KASAN reproducer (reallocation preconditions are path-dependent); scanner misses branch-local captures, helper-passed pointers, and macro sites; arch/, fs/, and most ethernet-driver TX fallback cow/linearize sites only pattern-screened; xfrm_input/exthdrs/ip6_gre/l2tp/sip sites read at function level but not all line-by-line deep-read before finalization.
